subject: Debrief: Staff ML Eng candidate — round-robin feedback & tiebreak
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Recruiter <hannah@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Debrief: Staff ML Eng candidate — round-robin feedback & tiebreak

Hi team,

Thanks for interviewing Evan Brooks yesterday. Quick request to close out this loop: please add your completed scorecards to the shared sheet (link below) and post any qualitative notes here by EOD. We have a slight score cluster between Evan and a second finalist — I'd like us to resolve asynchronously if possible so we can move to offer next week.

Action items (quick):
- Drop your numeric score (1-5) + 2-line rationale in the sheet
- If you think we need a live tiebreak, flag it explicitly and suggest 15–20 minute agenda items
- Attach your completed scorecard PDF if you used the template

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example-candidate-scores
Template attached: scorecard-template.xlsx

Thanks — I can run the tie-break poll if needed.

— David
Head of Platform ML Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scorecard-template.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Staff ML Eng candidate — round-robin feedback & tiebreak

Thanks David — uploaded my sheet and attaching my PDF scorecard. Summary below.

Score: 4
Strengths:
- Deep production experience with KV caching and attention optimizations
- Clear trade-offs understanding between latency and cost
Concerns:
- Needs more examples of system design at 100K qps / multi-region failover
Recommendation: Strong hire with onboarding focused on infra-scale playbooks.

Attachment: marissa_scorecard-evan.pdf

Uploaded my scores (3). Quick note on variance: my interview focused more on trade-offs and cultural fit; I flagged two uncertainty items that pulled my numeric lower. If we average: Evan = 3.75 (current), other finalist = 3.76 — razor thin.

Proposed next steps:
- Async tiebreak poll with two prompts: "System-design edge-case" + "Failure-recovery sequencing" — reviewers pick which candidate demonstrated clearer ownership.
- If votes still split 2-2, call will be needed.

If David wants, I can kick off a Doodle-style poll and include the two short prompts.

— Rishi

Appreciate the quick turns. Summary/next steps: 
- Scores (sheet): Marissa 4, Jonas 4, Grace 4, Rishi 3 -> mean 3.75 for Evan. Other finalist mean 3.76 as Rishi noted — inconclusive.
- Rishi: please send the two short prompts + a simple poll link. Set a deadline of 24 hours; if still split after poll we'll schedule a 20-min tiebreak call (I'll chair).
- Hannah: hold off on offers for both candidates until we resolve tiebreak. Thanks for being on standby.

I'll attach the compiled CSV and our PDFs to the candidate record after the poll. Good run — appreciate fast feedback.

— David
